title: Baby Sketch and 35 Years Later
content: On a hot, humid night 35 years ago, I sketched my new son as he slept, wondering where life would take him.Here's a video of him now. He's an Irish accordion player as well as a coder. He helped do the computer work for a new digital exhibition that will launch on June 29 called "From the Bridge: A View of Irish Traditional Music in New York."ITMA is committed to preserving, digitizing, and presenting valuable recordings of Irish music.
